novel_features.name: Fleet posture audit
novel_features.description: One PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN matrix across every FortiGate in your devices file for firmware, SSL-VPN exposure, admin accounts and FortiGuard licence expiry.

novel_features.name: Firmware audit
novel_features.description: Flags FortiGates below your per-branch firmware floor and how many patches each is behind the newest image offered in its branch.

novel_features.name: SSL-VPN exposure audit
novel_features.description: Grades each FortiGate and VDOM on whether SSL-VPN is enabled, listening on a WAN interface, and open to any source address.

novel_features.name: Admin account audit
novel_features.description: Flags admins with no trusted hosts (FAIL when HTTPS/SSH management is open on WAN), super_admin accounts without two-factor, WAN interfaces allowing HTTP or Telnet, and API users trusted from broad networks or using super_admin.

novel_features.name: Licence expiry audit
novel_features.description: One renewal queue of FortiGuard, FortiCare and service licences across the fleet, sorted by days left.

novel_features.name: Fleet health sweep
novel_features.description: One PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN row per FortiGate: HA config sync, IPsec tunnels down, SD-WAN members down, CPU and memory pressure, expiring certificates; anything it could not read makes the row UNKNOWN.

novel_features.name: Policy hygiene
novel_features.description: Lists unused, any-any accept, logging-disabled and disabled firewall policies per VDOM.

novel_features.name: Config change report
novel_features.description: Shows which FortiOS objects were added, removed or modified between two saved 'fleet backup' files (needs at least two backups per device; secrets are redacted, so a secret-only change is not reported).
